Method of Attack: Creates electromagnetic waves from a USB device connected to an air-gapped computer to leak data over radio frequency signals
Broadcasts data from an air-gapped computer's video display unit to a nearby receiver
USB dongle modified with an RF transmitter and receiver capable of bridging an air gap
Discoverer: Mordechai Guri, Matan Monitz, Yuval Elovici of Ben-Gurion University
Disclosed in the Edward Snowden leaks
Known from cybersecurity research and reports
Attack Vector: Malware installed on air-gapped computer using USB device
Modified USB dongle with RF capabilities
